tools.name: list_services
tools.description: List every service In Motion Marketing offers (SEO, paid ads, content, HubSpot, RevOps, web design, graphic design, app development and their sub-services) with a one-line summary and the URL of each page, as Markdown. Use to check whether the agency does a specific kind of B2B marketing work.

tools.name: get_pricing
tools.description: Get In Motion Marketing's current plans and prices (Advisory, Growth and Scale) in USD as Markdown, with what each plan includes, the terms and who each plan fits. Use when a user asks what the agency costs or which plan suits them.

tools.name: list_case_studies
tools.description: List In Motion Marketing's published client results and case studies as Markdown, with the client, the work and the outcome, and links to each case study. Use when a user asks for proof, examples or results.

tools.name: search_site
tools.description: Search inmotionmktg.com pages and blog posts by keyword. Returns up to 10 matches with title and URL. Use get_page to read a result.

tools.name: get_page
tools.description: Read one page of inmotionmktg.com as Markdown, given its path (for example /seo-agency/, /blog/cold-email-best-practices/ or /about/). Use after list_services or search_site to get the full details.

tools.name: get_strategy_call_link
tools.description: Get the link to book a free 20-minute strategy call with In Motion Marketing. Use when a user wants to talk to the agency, get a quote or start a project. Returns a URL the user opens to pick a time; this tool books nothing.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: list_services, search_site, get_page, get_strategy_call_link · Public sink: get_page.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: list_services, search_site, get_page, get_strategy_call_link · Public sink: get_page

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
